# Commerce

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

**Commerce** APIs enable partners to purchase Zoom products and manage subscriptions through the subscription lifecycle using APIs enabling B2B integrations and bringing efficiencies in partner selling motions. Partners can use these APIs to create new accounts, orders, and quotes. The APIs can also be used to modify, cancel, or renew subscriptions, view itemized invoices, and more.
